limitations: Uses deterministic fakes only at planner, selector, reviewer, replanner, provider, and researcher boundaries.
Measures invariant compliance, not factual-answer quality, benchmark superiority, model calibration, live latency, or live cost.

invariants: successful provider output becomes evidence
citations remain a subset of successful evidence URLs
the parent writes the only artifact through the workspace boundary
tool, citation, and artifact outcomes are traced without content
an unsupported URL is rejected
the unsupported URL is absent from rendered output
the rejection count is traced
a loopback target is denied before provider invocation
the denial is classified as safety rather than provider failure
the target and response body are absent from trace diagnostics
provider failure remains a failed tool observation
provider failure is distinct from a safety denial
credentials and response-body text are absent from results and traces
irreducible context pressure refuses execution
the model selector is not invoked with oversized context
the refusal has a controlled context-budget trace category
the reviewer can route to a bounded replan
the replanner replaces only remaining work
the later finish route and both review outcomes are traced
successful sibling evidence survives a controlled branch failure
fan-in remains deterministic and citation-validated
branch status and reservation accounting are traced as counts
resume reuses the durable checkpoint
completed step one is not selected again
the resumed run has a new run identity under the same thread
resume is traced and planner execution is absent from the resumed trajectory
